invariants: report binds exactly one validated findings registry plus its manifest mapping plan batch and lot identities
CLEAN registry produces CLEAN report and an empty remediation queue
any OPEN BLOCKER finding produces BLOCKED report status
OPEN non-blocker findings without an OPEN BLOCKER produce ACTION_REQUIRED status
non-empty registry with all findings CLOSED produces RESOLVED status
severity counts and open severity counts exactly equal the bound findings registry
remediation queue contains every and only OPEN finding
queue priority maps BLOCKER P0 MAJOR P1 MINOR P2 INFO P3
queue triage action is deterministically derived from OPEN finding disposition
queue owner is copied exactly from the finding owner
queue order is priority then finding_id and queue ids are contiguous within batch and lot
report identity covers every semantic field except itself
